name: @tedi-design-system/livewire-build
description: Stylesheet and Alpine-bundle build pipeline for aanndryyyy/tedi-design-system-livewire

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:fonts
scripts.build:js: esbuild resources/js/tedi.js --bundle --format=iife --target=es2017 --banner:js='/* TEDI Design System - Alpine behaviour bundle. Generated by npm run build:js from resources/js/ - edit the source there, not this file. The prose documenting each behaviour lives in the source. */' --outfile=dist/tedi.js
